title: NFL informs potential Jets target Brendan Sorsby there will be no 2026 Supplemental Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL informs potential Jets target Brendan Sorsby there will be no 2026 Supplemental Draft
sources.description: The Brendan Sorsby soap opera took yet another turn on Tuesday, with the NFL announcing that there will be no 2026 Supplemental Draft.
